gitguardian_enterprise_raw.dataset_description: GitGuardian is a code security platform that detects secrets exposed in source code repositories.

source_log_type.field_description: The event type of the GitGuardian record.

tags.field_description: The tags GitGuardian attached to the secret incident.

who.field_description: The developers involved in the GitGuardian secret incident.

id.field_description: The unique ID GitGuardian assigns to the secret incident or audit log entry.

display_name.field_description: The display name of the secret detector that triggered the GitGuardian incident.

severity.field_description: The numeric severity GitGuardian assigns to the secret incident.

category.field_description: The category of the GitGuardian secret incident.

status.field_description: The current remediation status of the GitGuardian secret incident.

assignee.field_description: The user the GitGuardian secret incident is assigned to.

repo_name.field_description: The name of the source code repository in which the secret was detected.

commit_sha.field_description: The SHA hash of the commit in which the secret was detected.

file_path.field_description: The path of the file in which the secret was detected.

api_url.field_description: The GitGuardian API URL of the secret incident resource.

actor_email.field_description: The email address of the GitGuardian user who performed the audited action.

actor_name.field_description: The name of the GitGuardian user who performed the audited action.

actor_ip.field_description: The IP address from which the GitGuardian user performed the audited action.

type.field_description: The type of action recorded in the GitGuardian audit trail.

payload.field_description: Additional details of the action recorded in the GitGuardian audit trail.

target_user_email.field_description: The email address of the GitGuardian user affected by the audited action.

url.field_description: The URL associated with the GitGuardian secret incident.
